notes.title: Flawless Darkness Official Release
notes.content:
-----------------------------------------------
Sorry, English dubbing in random mode is not supported yet.
I will update it as soon as possible.
-----------------------------------------------

[Update Notes]
[list]
[*]Official Release
[*]Added Random Mode
[*]Added Voice Subtitles
[*]Improved Gamepad Controls
[/list]

Hello, this is OldIce.

Flawless Darkness has completed its early access phase and is now officially released.

The update content has changed from the previously announced 100 stages development.
I have added a special feature called 'Random Mode'

While developing 60 stages, I realized that the mazes were getting bigger and there was more to memorize, making the game too difficult. I was also concerned that players had nothing to enjoy while waiting for Flawless Darkness updates.
Therefore, I added Random Mode with this official release.

Random Mode automatically generates random mazes.
You can adjust the maze size and obstacle density (including traps and monsters) to enjoy Flawless Darkness at your preferred difficulty level for as long as you want.
Although I haven't implemented all maze obstacles yet, I will add them in future updates.

Updates for Flawless Darkness will continue steadily, so please keep showing your interest.

Thank you.

-OldIce-

notes.title: Flawless Darkness 24.06.06. Small update information and future update notice
notes.content:
[b]Flawless Darkness 24.06.06. Small update information and future update notice[/b]


[b][Summary][/b]
From now on, “Flawless Darkness” supports “macOS”.
And it can be controlled with a “gamepad”.


[b][Detail][/b]
macOS can play just like Windows right now.

However, gamepads are not fully supported yet.

Controls are possible, but there are no instructions on how to control the actions in the game.

Until the gamepad is fully supported, you must be familiar with the controls for the actions described below before playing.


[b][Gamepad control method(based on XBOX)][/b]

Movement: "Cross keys" or "Left stick" or "Right stick" -------- Previous: "Arrow keys" or "WASD"

Action A (Radar & Signal Generator): "LB" or "RB" or "A" -------- Previous: "Space bar"

Action B (Sword & Shield): "LT" or "RT" or "X" -------- Previous: "Shift"

Menu: "B" -------- Previous: "Esc"

Visualization: "Right stick click" -------- Previous: "V"

Hide Description: "Menu Button" -------- Previous: "O"

Show keys pressed: "Show button" -------- Previously: "K"

Minimap: "Left stick click" -------- Previous: "M"


[b][Future update notice][/b]
When I finished early access, I aimed for stage 100.
However, after producing the 60th stage, I became concerned. This is because I thought that difficulty levels higher than this would be unnecessarily difficult and would be insignificant to those who cleared stage 60 even if the difficulty was lowered and other restrictions were imposed.
So, rather than continuing to increase the stage as before, I will apply a different method.
I will let you know once the specific direction is decided.

Thank you

notes.title: Flawless Darkness 1st update
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience! The first update of Flawless Darkness has finally been completed!
What is being updated is the 4th to 6th floors. There are a total of 30 mazes.
The added mazes include everything from arrow traps to sound-sensitive monsters that were only available in the demo version!
And for those who had difficulty playing the game, visible mode, show pressed key, and minimap were added.
In particular, the visible mode is a feature that allows people who have difficulty hearing sound to play this game.
This mod is not complete yet, but I will continue to improve it!

※ Although it has been tested, there may be bugs that were not found, so if you find any, please report them! ※

notes.title: Flawless Darkness has been released!
notes.content:
Flawless Darkness is finally released today!
You can play right now, so I hope you enjoy it!

There are still only 30 mazes. Among the things on the game introduction page, i haven't added many things yet, such as shields, traps, barriers, and hungry monsters, but i plan to proceed carefully while receiving feedback rather than rushing to add them.
Instead, in the demo version, you can try everything on the introduction page, so i hope you enjoy it until then.
I will continue updating until there are at least 100 mazes, so stay tuned!
Thank you!

notes.title: Flawless Darkness will be released soon!
notes.content:
Floris Darkness is set to release on the upcoming August 17th!
I am truly delighted to present the game to our users at last!
While the content is still limited, we will steadily expand it through continuous updates!
